settings.restart_required_suffix: requires a restart to take effect. Exit now?
settings.row.allow_plugin_loader: Allow Games to Control Plugin Loader
settings.row.allow_plugin_loader.desc: Lets a running game enable/disable the plugin loader itself via its own menu.
settings.row.async_gpu.desc: Runs GPU command processing on its own thread in parallel with the CPU. Faster.
settings.row.async_shaders.desc: Reduces the amount of time it takes to compile shaders.
settings.row.compile_boost.desc: Dramatically speeds up shader compiling speed but reduces GPU performance during that duration.
settings.row.cpu_clock.desc: Change the emulated CPU clock. Most games play well at 100%.
settings.row.cpu_jit.desc: Do not disable this unless explicitly needed. Huge performance drops.
settings.row.custom_textures.desc: Enable loading a custom texture pack for this game.
settings.row.disable_right_eye.desc: Disable this for huge speed boost. Only enable this if you have issues rendering the game on the bottom screen.
settings.row.disk_shader_cache.desc: Drastically reduces stuttering in-game by keeping compiled shaders on disk.
settings.row.download_covers.desc: Downloads every owned game's cover art from GameTDB, in every language GameTDB has it in. Titles or languages with no art on GameTDB are silently skipped.
settings.row.dump_textures.desc: Disable this unless you're making your own texture pack. Heavy on IO calls.
settings.row.fastmem.desc: Aliases guest RAM so the CPU JIT skips page-table walks. Disable if unstable.
settings.row.gametdb_enabled.desc: Show downloaded GameTDB cover art on the Game Details screen when available. Use Download All Covers below to actually fetch it - this only controls display.
settings.row.gpu_frame_log.desc: Writes gpu_frame_log.log and dynarmic_jit.log to the SD card for performance investigation. Leave off unless asked to capture logs.
settings.row.hw_shader.desc: Emulate shaders more efficiently on GPU.
settings.row.integer_scaling.desc: Scales the output 1:1 to the resolution of the game.
settings.row.language.desc: Also changes the frontend's own menu language, not just games.
settings.row.layout.desc: Screen arrangement this title boots into.
settings.row.layout_cycle.desc: Screen layouts to swap between when tapping screen-swap key.
settings.row.linear_filtering.desc: Smooth out jagged edges at the cost of sharpness.
settings.row.movie_throttle.desc: Core Clock percentage used while a movie/cutscene is playing back. Most games play well at 45%.
settings.row.movie_throttle_enabled.desc: Automatically throttles the CPU clock during movie/cutscene playback. Disable if you notice freezes when adjusting clock speeds.
settings.row.new3ds.desc: Emulate New 3DS. Might cause performance drops but necessary to boot some games.
settings.row.plugin_loader.desc: Loads a .3gx plugin from luma/plugins/ on the SD card at boot, same as real Luma3DS.
settings.row.pointer_source.desc: For those who don't want to use touch screen, use a virtual cursor.
settings.row.preload_textures.desc: Enable use of custom textures in-game. Place them in /load/textures/<TITLE_ID>/.
settings.row.region.desc: Change the region of the console.
settings.row.resolution.desc: Change the resolution the game is played at. 1x is 400x240.
settings.row.show_fps.desc: Shows FPS on the top left of the screen.
settings.row.show_shader_compile_progres: Shows a "Compiling shaders" indicator during gameplay while shaders finish building.
settings.row.skip_cpu_write.desc: Debug option that skips flushing/removing cached GPU surfaces for CPU cycles.
settings.row.skip_slow_draw.desc: Debug option that skips the CPU vertex/triangle fallback entirely.
settings.row.skip_texture_copy.desc: Debug option that skips non-cached source surface.
settings.row.strict_gpu_sync.desc: Waits for the GPU thread to catch up every frame instead of letting it lag behind. Only matters with Async GPU on.
settings.row.ubershaders.desc: Renders draws with a generic shader instead of skipping them, removing screen bleed.
settings.row.vsync.desc: Reduces screen tearing at the cost of increased input latency.
